newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: KLZ revises down full year earnings.
newsitem.headline: KLZ revises down full year earnings.

text.p: Building materials and office supplies group KLZ Ltd said on Tuesday it had revised down its full year pre-tax earnings estimate due to weaker than expected trading conditions in its second half.
"The directors now expect the full year earnings before interest, tax amortisation and abnormals (EBITA) to be in the range of A$21 million to A$22 million," the company said.
KLZ's EBITA totalled A$15.4 million for the year to June 30, 1996.

KLZ posted a first half EBITA of A$12.02 million in February. When announcing its half year results, KLZ said it expected its second half earnings to exceed the first half, if there was a continuation of the prevailing trading conditions.

"KLZ has encountered weaker trading conditions in the second half and has made slower than anticipated progress in some initiatives in the electrical products and printing groups," KLZ said in a statement to the Australian Stock Exchange (ASX).
The company said it still forecast a full year dividend payout of between 18 cents to 20 cents per share.
